name: darkmux-viewer-next
description: Packet 1 of the viewer -> React port: the scaffold. React + TanStack Query + ts-rs types over the existing daemon JSON endpoints, built to one committed self-contained artifact (crates/darkmux-serve/assets/next.html) served at GET /next.

scripts.build: bun run typecheck && vite build && bun run copy-artifact
scripts.types:regen: (cd .. && cargo test -p darkmux-serve export_bindings --lib && cargo test -p darkmux-crew --features ts-export export_bindings --lib && cargo test -p darkmux-lab --features ts-export export_bindings --lib)
scripts.types:check: bun run types:regen && git diff --exit-code -- src/types/generated
